node.create.label: Create layer
node.create.params: {type: rectangle|ellipse|polygon|star|line|arrow|vector|text|frame|section|component|slice, x?, y? (relative to the parent frame; groups don't count), width?, height?, parent? (id; default: the page), index?, name?, text? (for text), path? (SVG path data for vector), props? {node.set keys}, select? (default true)}

variable.create.label: Create variable
variable.create.params: {collection, name, type: color|number|string|boolean, value (default mode) | values {modeName: value}}

variable.set.label: Set variable value
variable.set.params: {variable, mode? (name or id; default first), value | {alias: variable} (same type, no loops)}

variable.bind.label: Bind variable
variable.bind.params: {ids?, field (fill|stroke (first paint)|fills/<i>/color|strokes/<i>/color|fills/<i>/stops/<j>/color (gradient stops)|effects/<i>/<offsetX|offsetY|radius|startRadius|spread|color>|layoutGrids/<i>/<size|count|gutter|offset>|componentProperties/<name> (instances: boolean/text properties; variant properties take string variables naming a value)|width|height|opacity (percent)|cornerRadius|gap|paddingHorizontal|characters|visible|fontSize…; list indices bottom first), variable (null unbinds)}

variable.setMode.label: Set variable mode
variable.setMode.params: {ids? (frames/page), collection, mode (id or name; null: Auto, inherited from the parent)}

variable.export.label: Export variables
variable.export.params: {collections? [ids or names; default every collection of this file, not library copies], format? (json (default): the local variables JSON that variable.import reads | css: custom properties, the default mode on :root and each other mode on [data-<collection>="<mode>"]), path? (write it there)}  → {text}, or {path} when written
